turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: I’m here because when I know I have to cross a bridge, I get terrified before I’m even on it. My heart pounds, my hands get sweaty on the steering wheel—or the armrest—and it’s just this awful rush of fear.

symptom_reasoning.S063: The patient describes immediate anticipatory terror with pounding heart and sweaty hands when bridge crossing becomes unavoidable.

turns.doctor_question: Does this intense fear ever happen out of the blue, when you're not near or thinking about a bridge, or is it only triggered by bridges specifically?
turns.patient_response: It’s only when I know I’m going to have to cross a bridge. Even before I’m on it, the fear starts right up—my heart pounds and my hands get damp.

symptom_reasoning.S063: Fear with autonomic symptoms begins immediately upon anticipating an unavoidable bridge crossing and is specifically triggered by bridges.
